description: Implement Byte-Pair Encoding tokenizer (bpe.py) and demo script (demo.py) with __init__.py.
steps: 1. Create src/lecture-01/__init__.py

4. Verify all files run without errors

task: lecture-02: Resource Accounting - FLOPs, arithmetic intensity, mixed precision
steps: 1. Create src/lecture-02/__init__.py
2. Write flops_counter.py: count_parameters, estimate_training_flops, memory footprint estimation
3. Write arithmetic_intensity.py: compute arithmetic intensity for matmul/attention/elementwise, roofline model visualization
4. Write mixed_precision.py: demonstrate fp16/bf16/fp32 differences, simple AMP training loop example
5. Verify all files run without errors
acceptance-criteria: flops_counter.py correctly counts parameters and estimates FLOPs. arithmetic_intensity.py produces roofline plot. mixed_precision.py demonstrates precision differences. __init__.py exists. All files run without errors.

description: Implement full Transformer model (transformer.py) and tests (test_transformer.py) with __init__.py.
steps: 1. Create src/lecture-03/__init__.py
2. Write transformer.py: MultiHeadAttention, TransformerBlock, TransformerLM with causal masking, pre-norm/post-norm

acceptance-criteria: MultiHeadAttention implements QKV projection and scaled dot-product attention. TransformerBlock includes Attention+MLP+residual+LayerNorm. TransformerLM has Embedding+Blocks+LM head. Causal masking works. Pre-norm and post-norm supported. Forward pass runs. All tests pass.
